children: PSU dividend kings, Sept. 14 -- Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) stocks with an attractive dividend yield remain among investors' radar because of stable business and regular income opportunities. Coal India, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC), Bharat Petroleum Corporation, and REC Limited, are among the top 8 PSU stocks with highest dividend yield in the financial year 2025-26.

The top eight PSU stocks have an estimated dividend yield of more than 5%, with top 3 stocks on the list exceeding the 6.5% annual dividend yield mark, according to a latest SBI Securities report. Check the full list here.

With a 5.4% dividend yield, MSTC India, ranks 8th on the list of 'PSU stocks with highest dividend yield'. Its shares closed marginally higher at Rs.738.05 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.5,195.87 crore. The stock has a return on equity (ROE) of 33%. Its share price value has surged 43% in 2026 so far and around 37% in one year. T

BPCL has a dividend yield of 5.5% in FY26, as per SBI Securities report. The Maharatna PSU stock closed marginally higher at Rs.304.5 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.1,32,106.39 crore on Friday, September 11.

The stock touched its 52-week high of Rs.391.85 per share on February 5, 2026. The stock dipped to its 52-week low of Rs.266.55 per share on April 2, 2026. With a return on equity (ROE) of 17.34%, its share price value has 20% year to date (YTD). But it has surged around 6.34% in three months.

ONGC stock has a dividend yield of 5.7% for FY26, as per SBI Securities data. The PSU stock closed 1.88% lower at Rs.232.55 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.2,92,554.39 crore on Friday, September 11. With a return on equity (ROE) of 12.82%, its share price value has declined 2.25% YTD, and around 0.47% in one year.

Fifth on the list is power financier, REC Limited. The Maharatna PSU has a dividend yield of 5.9% in FY26. The stock closed marginally lower at Rs.312.9 per share on BSE on Friday, September 11. With a return on equity (ROE) of 18.96%, its share price value has 14.88% in 2026 so far, and around 16.49% in one year.

It has a dividend yield of 6%. The PSU stock closed 0.65% lower at Rs.168.75 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.2,885.69 crore on Friday. With a 17.95% ROE, its share price value has declined 8.66% year to date (YTD), and around 26.7% in one year.

The state-run coal giant is in third position in terms of its FY25 dividend yield. Coal India stock closed 1.82% lower at Rs.425.6 per share on BSE on Friday. Its ROE stood at 102.46%. Its share price value has surged 6.3% in 2026 so far and around 8% in one year.

Maharatna PSU has a dividend yield of 6.7% for FY26. Its share price closed 0.85% lower at Rs.351 per share on BSE on Friday. The stock's ROE stood at 3.18%. Its share price value has declined 29% in 2026 so far and around 11.79% in one year.

The power trading firm has a dividend yield of 7.7% in FY26. The PSU stock closed 0.59% lower at Rs.152.9 per share on BSE with an MCap of Rs.4,525.97 crore. The stock dipped 6.14% in 2026 so far.
